propositions: Criteria assembly raises CriteriaError but workflow recorder loses typed exception identity, preserving only a string, causing all unrecovered scripted failures to route through generic LLM degradation.

The degraded verdict builder unconditionally stamps llm_unavailable=true even when no LLM/batch frame executed and the failure originated in deterministic scripted assemble, misclassifying local config faults as provider outages.

Operators receive INDETERMINATE with llm_unavailable=true and no actionable diagnostic when a stale/malformed criteria file is loaded, directing them toward provider credentials rather than build/configuration issues.

The repair must preserve fail-closed INDETERMINATE behavior with full deterministic coverage while emitting a distinct config_fault marker, removing the false llm_unavailable flag, and naming the installed build as the suspect.

Criteria assembly must emit a failed StepResult with stable failure_kind=criteria_config to enable typed dispatch; verdict assembly must recognize only that exact marker before generic degradation and route it through a deterministic config-fault path.
